free_text_description: Global asset storage and rendering pipeline for Creative Cloud subscribers (30M+ users). Users upload, store, sync, and render creative assets (PSD, AI, video files) across desktop and mobile. Architecture uses S3 for primary object storage (50PB+, multi-region), Lambda for image thumbnail generation and format conversion, Step Functions for video transcoding orchestration, MediaConvert for video processing, CloudFront for global asset delivery, and RDS Aurora PostgreSQL for metadata catalog. Write-heavy workload with 500K uploads/hour peak. Uses S3 Intelligent-Tiering for cost optimization and S3 Replication for multi-region availability. Security-critical: all assets encrypted with customer-managed KMS keys.

architecture_context.compute: Lambda (10K concurrent, ARM64), Step Functions (video pipeline)

pain_points: S3 costs growing 20% YoY with user base growth
Lambda cold starts affect thumbnail generation latency
Aurora writer instance scaling during upload spikes
Cross-region replication costs for disaster recovery
